mapper.select: SELECT category_id AS categoryId, name, notification AS notification FROM CATEGORY ORDER BY category_id ASC

SELECT p.post_id as postId, p.title, p.content, p.like_count as likeCount, p.dislike_count as dislikeCount, p.report_count as reportCount, p.view_count as viewCount, p.user_id as userId, u.nickname as userNickname, p.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, c.notification as categoryNotification, p.created_at as createdAt, p.updated_at as updatedAt
, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_post_like upl WHERE upl.post_id = p.post_id AND upl.user_id = #{viewerUserId} ) AS likedByMe
, FALSE AS likedByMe
FROM POST p JOIN USER u ON p.user_id = u.user_id JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
c.notification != 0
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.post_id as postId, p.title, p.content, p.like_count as likeCount, p.dislike_count as dislikeCount, p.report_count as reportCount, p.view_count as viewCount, p.user_id as userId, u.nickname as userNickname, p.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, c.notification as categoryNotification, p.created_at as createdAt, p.updated_at as updatedAt, FALSE AS likedByMe FROM POST p JOIN USER u ON p.user_id = u.user_id JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.notification = 0 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT p.post_id as postId, p.title, p.content, p.like_count as likeCount, p.dislike_count as dislikeCount, p.report_count as reportCount, p.view_count as viewCount, p.user_id as userId, u.nickname as userNickname, p.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, c.notification as categoryNotification, p.created_at as createdAt, p.updated_at as updatedAt
, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_post_like upl WHERE upl.post_id = p.post_id AND upl.user_id = #{viewerUserId} ) AS likedByMe
, FALSE AS likedByMe
FROM POST p JOIN USER u ON p.user_id = u.user_id JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POST ( title, content, like_count, dislike_count, report_count, view_count, user_id, category_id ) VALUES ( #{dto.title}, #{dto.content}, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{userId}, #{dto.categoryId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE POST SET title = #{dto.title}, content = #{dto.content}, category_id = #{dto.categoryId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_post_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id = #{postId}
